game_title: Code Reading Relay – Sunset Dunes Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes, dunes at sunset: the desert nomad must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes: dunes at sunset
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunset Dunes, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about predicted to power up the desert nomad and open the supply tent.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sunset Dunes'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Sunset Dunes.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
